question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What was your favorite part of Spirit Week?
Have you ever participated in Spirit Week events?

nodes.text: $ZOE races across the cafeteria and tackles Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get your hands off our lizard!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fine, fine! Take him!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Tom? What are you doing here? Why are you helping Wilson High? I thought you went to Spartan Academy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I `used` to go there. But when my dad lost his fortune, I got kicked out. Now I'm slumming it with the riff-raff at Wilson High...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]used[/i][/color] to go there. But when my dad lost his fortune, I got kicked out. Now I'm slumming it with the riff-raff at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And those peasants are... Ugh... 'Hazing' me for my spot on the basketball team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like you'll have to find another way to earn your place there. Lyle's not going anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fine. Now, if you'll unhand me, I'd like to leave with what's left of my dignity.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good, get out of here! And don't come back!
Tom storms off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, Tom's just a spoiled rich kid who always causes us trouble. But it looks like he might not be so rich anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, the important thing here is that Lyle's safe! Mission accomplished, team.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's all thanks to $ZOE's quick moves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right! Good tackle, cousin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks!
After school that day, $ZOE and Sam meet up with Taylor to hand off Lyle.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work, girls. I knew I could trust you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No sweat!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: People are going to be totally psyched that we foiled Wilson's plans, and bringing out Lyle will be the perfect end to the pep rally.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is going to be a major boost to school spirit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw, that's sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It would just mean a lot to me if you came to the game.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not crazy about the idea, but if you want me to... Well, I'll think about it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you want to support Jacob? And Andy? And everyone else on the team?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... Yeah, those guys are cool, but they don't really need me there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They've got the whole cheerleading squad cheering them on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess... But I'm sure they'd appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'll think about it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Thanks for coming to support the basketball team! Jacob, as the team captain, can you say a few words?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sure. Uh. We've got a great team this year, and we think we've got a shot at taking down Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't you mean you `know` you can beat Wilson High?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you mean you [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you can beat Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, right! Um, yeah. We're totally going to win.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Man, the basketball team is so out of it... Wilson High already has them psyched out! I guess this Spirit Week really needs to get them ready for a fight.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, let's have a word from the newest addition to the basketball team... Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Any thoughts on the big game?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh... Don't we lose ever year?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, we've heard enough from the team. Enjoy the bonfire, everyone!
As everyone disperses, $ZOE spots Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! You made it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Of course. Gotta support the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're not more into basketball. Your friend Jacob's the captain and all.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... I guess you could say I'm not crazy about the whole team.
$ZOE looks where Howard is glaring and sees Kenji talking to Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji, I really don't get why you're doing this. You always said that school sports are lame.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Maybe I want to try something new. Sometimes people change, right, Linda?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji... Sports have nothing to do with how I'm feeling.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If you're so in love with someone else, maybe you'd be better off talking to `him` right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you're so in love with someone else, maybe you'd be better off talking to [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] right now.

nodes.text: Kenji pushes past Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This is such a mess...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, yeah. I'm fine. Sorry. I really hate all this drama. I probably shouldn't have come tonight. I just want to keep a low profile until it all blows over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... You're coming to the game on Friday, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know... I don't exactly want to be cheering for the guy who stole my girl... Even if things are rocky between them right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On the count of three, let's scream as loud as we can, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One... Two... Three!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeeek!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eeeek!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whoa, what's going on? Somebody getting attacked over there?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What happened? What happened? Those screams were something straight out of a horror movie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened is that we've got a killer team that can't wait to take on Wilson High on Friday!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Ah, what a clever rouse.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Ha ha! Whew.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good work! I'll take it from here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's get a bucket.
Sam and $ZOE haul a huge bucket of salt water up from the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, we throw it on whoever's closest! Ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ewww and cold.
Everyone stops talking and turns to stare.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, girls, but we needed to get everyone's attention.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, you've got our attention. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll take it from here, girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that got everyone's attention... But I don't think Sam and I made any friends with that move.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I guess you'll be at the bonfire tonight, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep! We'll be there all night. Gooo Lizards! Will you be there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not really into basketball, but I wouldn't mind getting to see you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I guess I'll see you tonight!
That evening at the beach, everyone is around the bonfire talking and joking around. Taylor grabs a microphone...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem! Hello, is this on?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Looks like the sound system isn't working.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, annoying! Remind me to fire the AV club later.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But now how are we going to get everyone's attention?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I'm not going to waste my voice shouting over everyone! Sam and $ZOE! Get everyone to quiet down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, right! We can do that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On it. I guess... Maybe we can try shouting over everyone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, maybe we need something even bigger. What if we throw some water on the crowd? That ought to get their attention.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my goodness, I can't believe I'm actually doing this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There, you're totally cute. Now, let's go to school.
Sam and $ZOE meet up with the rest of the cheerleaders at school...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, not bad, new girl. I like the initiative. Nothing gets guys to pay attention like showing a little skin...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Looking good, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sweeet. I love Spirit Week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Young lady! What are you `wearing?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Young lady! What are you [color=#3b78e2][i]wearing?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... it's for Spirit Week?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well... I suppose I can let this slide, since it's for school spirit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! I can't believe I let Sam talk me into wearing this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa. Hey, $ZOE. What's with the... Um... Lack of a shirt?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, y'know... Color day. I totally forgot this morning, and it turns out that this bikini top is the only thing I had that was color-appropriate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Haha... It's a little crazy, but I like a girl who goes all-out for Spirit Week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... Okay... I guess we'd better go to school.
Sam and $ZOE meet up with the rest of the cheerleaders at school...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That's... A lot of yellow.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you wearing?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Yellow... For Spirit Week...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes, we're cheerleaders, and we have to set a good example by participating, but the most important thing is to `always look hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, we're cheerleaders, and we have to set a good example by participating, but the most important thing is to [color=#3b78e2][i]always look hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Understood, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, I guess wearing this bird suit all day is going to be punishment enough. Get out of here.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha ha! Polly want a cracker?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Uh oh, looks like you ruffled her feathers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Grrr... Stupid bird suit...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa. Hey, $ZOE. What's with the bird costume?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, y'know... Color day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Haha... Okay. It's a little crazy, but I like a girl who goes all-out for Spirit Week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't think I look ridiculous?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wouldn't go that far, but you're the hottest ridiculous bird-girl that I've ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww... Thanks.
$ZOE chases after Lyle... But runs straight into one of the lunch tables! She goes flying onto the table!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa, watch it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: My hummus...
$ZOE looks down and sees that her hand is in a bowl of hummus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eww... Er... I mean, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you okay? Here, let me help you up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks. I'm fine. But what about Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Um... I came back to make sure you were all right...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Yeah, and there wasn't a lot I could do when he jumped into a sports car and raced off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guess they've got Lyle now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... We really messed that one up. Taylor's going to be furious.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, it's her fault for putting us on lizard-watch to begin with.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'm sure she'll understand.
After school, Taylor drops by $ZOE's locker.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, I'm ready to take Lyle off your hands.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er... About that... We sort of lost him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! You `lost` him? You had `one` job today! How could you and your cousin screw it up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! You [color=#3b78e2][i]lost[/i][/color] him? You had [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] job today! How could you and your cousin screw it up?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, you two aren't as sorry as you're going to be. People are going to be totally demoralized when they hear about this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll be lucky to get `anyone` to show up to the game without Lyle. I've cut girls from the squad for less than this, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll be lucky to get [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] to show up to the game without Lyle. I've cut girls from the squad for less than this, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be keeping an eye on the two of you, and there better not be any more mistakes like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp...
After a few classes, $ZOE and Sam head to lunch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, how are we going to keep Lyle safe during lunch?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know, but I'm `so` ready for this to be over.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, but I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] ready for this to be over.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! $ZOE! Sam! What's with the lizard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! For Spirit Week, Taylor's making us keep an eye on Lyle so the Wilson High guys don't steal him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, man, that's a good idea. I remember when Lyle got lizard-napped last year.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We had to sneak into Wilson High and steal their badger and set up this exchange... One of the football players got busted for getting caught on camera...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was a complete mess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess we're going to have to really make sure we keep Lyle safe today.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I can help you out with that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? You'd do that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure. On the football team, we're all about protecting Lyle. Come on, we can keep an eye on him while we eat.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew.
Howard, $ZOE, and Sam sit down at one of the lunch tables with Howard's friends.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, man. Have you met $ZOE and Sam?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so. What's with your friend in the cage there? Is that our beloved mascot, Lyle?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yep. The cheerleaders are keeping him safe during Spirit Week.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, ha ha! Right. Hey, it's cool you guys are doing so much for the basketball team. We all really appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just doing our job.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `Man`, do you remember the hazing for the football team? When we had to eat those...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Man[/i][/color], do you remember the hazing for the football team? When we had to eat those...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Don't gross the girls out.
Suddenly, across the cafeteria, people start shouting!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's going on over there? Is it some kind of fight?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Dude, stop trying to start trouble! What are you even doing at our school?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Get your hands off me! It's a free country! I can go wherever I want!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, that's Skazz! He's a Wilson High guy. I bet he's up to something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no one's getting their hands on Lyle... Not today...
$ZOE looks down and sees Lyle's cage is gone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! Sam! Lyle's been stolen!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There! That guy! He's got the cage!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Quick! Catch him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'd better check to make sure you didn't, like, cut off his tail or something.
$ZOE carefully opens the cage and pulls Lyle out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He doesn't `look` like he's bleeding... But I can't tell if he won't hold still...
nodes.text_bbcode: He doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]look[/i][/color] like he's bleeding... But I can't tell if he won't hold still...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ouch! He bit me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Careful! Don't let him...
Lyle jumps out of $ZOE's hands and runs off between the desks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot! Class is about to start! Hurry, we have to grab him!
Sam and $ZOE dive between the chairs, searching the ground as the bell rings!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: $ZOE, Sam, is there something you want to share with the class?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just dealing with a little animal crisis.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Is this what you're looking for?
Ms. Prez points to Lyle, sitting on her desk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp. Yeah, that's our lizard. Thanks, Ms. Prez.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, no more interruptions. Take your seats, girls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, so, what do you do to comfort a `lizard?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, so, what do you do to comfort a [color=#3b78e2][i]lizard?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... When Puddles gets scared, we pet him, right? So...
$ZOE reaches into Lyle's cage and pets his head.

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hiss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Good lizard... It's all going to be okay...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew, $ZOE. So gross.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least Lyle calmed down. Crisis averted.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Okay, class, settle down. It's time to start today's lecture.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, squad, I've called you here today to discuss this week... The most important week of the year for the squad `and` for the school...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, squad, I've called you here today to discuss this week... The most important week of the year for the squad [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] for the school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Spirit Week! We've got a full week to plan, along with the huge pep rally on Thursday.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As all of you should know, our boys' basketball team has a big game against Wilson High on Friday...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, come on! We lose to them `every` year.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, come on! We lose to them [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] year.

nodes.text: There's a sudden burst of laughter from the back of the gym! Everyone turns to see a group of Wilson High cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Well, well. It looks like even the cheerleaders at this loser school know that they don't have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, doesn't your squad have anything better to do than lurk around our gym? Really, Porscha, it's just pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Just stopping by to have a friendly chat, Taylor. Where's your ugly little school mascot? Aren't you still keeping him in the science lab?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're here to pull some kind of prank, you can forget it.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Look, why don't you girls stop wasting your time? Everyone knows your team is useless.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Didn't you have to scrape the bottom of the barrel to even make a full team? I heard you've got some random Auto-Shop guy who's never played a sport before...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And some poor kid with an eyepatch! How can he even make a single shot if he can only see out of one eye?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey! Don't make fun of Andy! He lost his eye rescuing kittens from a burning orphanage in Guatemala!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: I guess it's a good thing no one at this school even cares enough to show up and watch them get humiliated.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We'll just see about that. Now, get out of here before I call security on all of you little twerps!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: We were just leaving anyway. Come on, girls.
Porscha and her cheerleaders leave...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, that's it! Squad, we're going to have the best Spirit Week in the history of this school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And by the end of it, not only will our basketball team be chomping at the bit to take down Wilson High, but every seat in the stands will be filled.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're with you, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I like your enthusiasm, new girl. As a matter of fact, I've got a special assignment today for you and Sam...
Taylor reaches into the bag next to her and pulls out a cage!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Porscha wasn't making a social call today. I bet she was trying to scope out where we're keeping this little guy... Our school mascot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I stopped by the science lab before our meeting to pick him up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every year, we have great plans for him at the pep rally, and every year, Wilson High somehow manages to steal him.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `But not this year.` Sam, $ZOE, as the newest members of the squad, you two have the honor of protecting our beloved mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But not this year.[/i][/color] Sam, $ZOE, as the newest members of the squad, you two have the honor of protecting our beloved mascot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... Yay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just make sure nothing happens to him today. I'll take him home tonight, and my dad's home security system will protect him for the rest of the week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure. That shouldn't be too hard...

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hissssss!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eek!
$ZOE and Sam head to class, carrying Lyle with them...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't believe we got stuck with this little monster!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know, I think he's kind of cute.
Sam drops Lyle's cage down under her desk. Suddenly, Lyle starts thrashing around!

nodes.speaker: Lyle
nodes.text: Hiss! Hiss!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! I think I broke the lizard! What's wrong with him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We won't let it happen again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're sorry we held up the team.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good. Nice to see you new girls have the right attitude. Just make sure you're early from now on, and we shouldn't have a problem.
$ZOE and Sam sit down next to Maria.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We got here when you told us to get here!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's a little saying in cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're early, you're on time. If you're on time, you're late. And if you're late, Taylor kicks you off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm not about to let two new girls who haven't even earned their stripes walk all over our system!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gulp! Sorry, Taylor. $ZOE, she gets confused sometimes. Don't you, $ZOE? Now `come on` and sit down!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gulp! Sorry, Taylor. $ZOE, she gets confused sometimes. Don't you, $ZOE? Now [color=#3b78e2][i]come on[/i][/color] and sit down!

nodes.text: Sam yanks $ZOE's arm and pulls her down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, that's it for our pep rally! If you want to see more of us and the boys' basketball team, don't forget to come out to the game tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We did our best... I just hope it was enough to get people excited about the game...
$ZOE catches Jill!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I knew I could count on you!
The routine ends, and everyone applauds!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hot.
$ZOE panics! She reaches for Jill, but misses!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Whoaaa!
Jill crashes to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey! What's the big idea?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Where's Lyle the Lizard? Bring out the lizard!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Lyle's... Er... On vacation right now.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What the...?! Did Wilson High steal him again?! I'm tired of those losers getting the drop on us.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What shot do we have at winning a basketball game if we can't even hold onto our mascot?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, don't get discouraged! This is a pep rally! Let's just move along...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I think we've got it all. Thanks, $Scott! I'm sure you'll have fun in the race!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... I hope so. See you at the pep rally.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's get this stuff back to the school.
A few minutes later, the gym is packed, and $ZOE's obstacle course is set up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey everyone! Can I have your attention?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you've got to have something silly at the end.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, now. Let's not get too crazy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right! Maybe they have to finish the race by hitting themselves in the face with...

nodes.prompt: They hit themselves in the face with...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: They hit themselves in the face with...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh, man. What did I get myself into?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, then what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should probably have something that makes it harder for them to complete the race.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Really? Uh... I mean, do we really need to make it harder?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We could make them go blindfolded! Or have them put their heads on the end of a baseball bat and spin around ten times?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! Let's make them...
Just then, Taylor blows a whistle, calling everyone back together.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, squad. I've been watching everyone's progress... And one of you really stood out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Great work out there! You really know how to talk to people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everyone should follow $ZOE's example.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, squad. I've been watching everyone's progress, and I have to say, I'm `really` disappointed.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, squad. I've been watching everyone's progress, and I have to say, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But one of you did even worse than everyone else...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! Do you even `want` anyone to come to this basketball game? Because as far as I can tell, you're `trying` turn people against us.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE! Do you even [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] anyone to come to this basketball game? Because as far as I can tell, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] turn people against us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just get your act together, okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, we've got the big pep rally tomorrow, so I want everyone bringing their 'A' game, all right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Right!
The next morning, the cheerleading squad meets outside of the school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, team. Maria, have you got the flyers?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Check!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jill and Nicole, did you two work out the tricks for the routine?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Got it down. We're throwing Jill in a fifth degree death spin!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, sounds great.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, do we have some silly game lined up to play?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ummm  about that... I kind of... Forgot.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica! This is no time for amateur-hour mistakes! Your top-of-the-pyramid privileges are officially revoked.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But... I have delicate knees!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, you're lucky I'm not cutting you from the squad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, new girls, time to get to work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Thanks to Jessica spacing out, you two are going to have to spend your lunch period today getting some kind of obstacle course prepped. Okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, sure! We can do it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good. Get it done.
At lunch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are we going to do, $ZOE? We don't even have a car...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll think of something... Maybe we can find a store that's close...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong, girls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've got to put together an obstacle course for the pep rally today... But we don't even have a way to get to the store to buy supplies.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that all? Well, quit worrying. I can give you girls a ride.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. No problem.
Howard drives $ZOE and Sam to the party store...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, guys. Lookin' for some party supplies?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $Scott...? You're our Student Body President, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's me. The one and only.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... I hate to be a spoil sport, but shouldn't you be at school? I thought Student Body Presidents were responsible...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, it's not like that. Sometimes I pick up an hour here during lunch, when someone else needs a lunch break.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I'll be back in time for class. Now, what brings you here in the middle of the day?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We need some supplies for the pep rally later today. We've got to design a little obstacle course.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, I think Taylor talked me into being in the race at the pep rally.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We've got stuff for that. Why don't you come with me and take a look? Just promise you won't make it `too` hard.
nodes.text_bbcode: We've got stuff for that. Why don't you come with me and take a look? Just promise you won't make it [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] hard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No promises. Now, let's see what you've got.
$Scott opens the door to the back room...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! You've got everything here... Tiny pink tricycles, funny hats, whipped cream pies...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, focus. What should we get?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's usually some kind of race... So... Let's have them race...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The girls' basketball team is awesome. Everyone knows that! The problem with the guys is that they're terrible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The only way we can get people into it is if we do all of this buildup.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I guess the guys `are` really pathetic.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess the guys [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] really pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah. They need all the help they can get.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how about it? Will you come to the game?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Maybe... I guess it could be funny to see how bad they are...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Great! As long as you're there.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ha ha! You guys really are desperate. Okay, we'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great. See you guys later.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Thanks for helping, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course. Glad I could lend a hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know we should have had some more events to help you. But girls' basketball just isn't popular enough.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And you're saying that instead of fixing it, we should just let it go?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know, this is all just a self-perpetuating cycle. Everyone says it's not popular, so you don't advertise it...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And then it stays unpopular!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Okay, okay, we get your point! We're sorry! We'll do better next year, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure, whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's get out of here, Keith...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, thanks for trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... But I think I made even more of a mess out of it.
$ZOE leaves Denni and her friends and spots Keith talking to a table of girls...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: So, yeah, you should come check out the game.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hold on a second. I'm on the girls' basketball team, and I don't remember the cheerleaders drumming up this much support for any of `our` games.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold on a second. I'm on the girls' basketball team, and I don't remember the cheerleaders drumming up this much support for any of [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] games.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah! And the girls have a much better record than the guys.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh... There's an explanation for that... And it's... Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes! I'd better go help Keith.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, girls! There `is` a good reason for that. It's because...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, girls! There [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a good reason for that. It's because...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: School spirit?! But we're going to lose! If we're just going to lose, how's that going to build school spirit?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, we don't know for `sure` that we're going to lose. There's always a chance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we don't know for [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] that we're going to lose. There's always a chance.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Right... So I should waste my Friday night on a `chance` that our team won't suffer a crushing defeat?
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... So I should waste my Friday night on a [color=#3b78e2][i]chance[/i][/color] that our team won't suffer a crushing defeat?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry, but I don't think we're interested.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, this is no time to get discouraged. I need to find someone else to motivate...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so we might end up losing. But the point is that we don't send our classmates out there to face that alone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, think about how the basketball players feel. They've got to go in there and fight, even though they know they're probably going to get crushed.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess it's kind of cool, in a tragic way... Like doomed warriors fighting even though they have no hope...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And the `least` we can do is be there to support them, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: And the [color=#3b78e2][i]least[/i][/color] we can do is be there to support them, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well... I guess it would be pretty sad if no one even cared.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Exactly! So I'll see you guys there?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess we'll think about it... It doesn't sound so bad. Right, Spike?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll take what I can get. Thanks!
$ZOE spots a group of freshmen sitting at one of the back tables.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here goes nothing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys! Coming to the basketball game on Friday?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Basketball? Meh. I'm only a freshman, but even `I` know that we lose that game every year.
nodes.text_bbcode: Basketball? Meh. I'm only a freshman, but even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know that we lose that game every year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who told you that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: My big sister, Raven. She went here a few years ago, and she said the boys' basketball team was so bad no one even talked about it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's true.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So what's the point of going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The point is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just think about it. You've got to calculate the angle to throw the ball at... How much force to use...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: With the variables of how high you jump and if the other team will get in the way...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: When you put it that way, it does present an intriguing challenge...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess it couldn't hurt to check it out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awesome! See you guys there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One group down... Now to find some more people!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aren't there tons of sports games? Like the one with football. And the one with soccer! So it's just like watching a video game!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: I hate to point out a flaw in a beautiful girl's argument, but it's fun to `play` video games... Not to watch other people play them.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate to point out a flaw in a beautiful girl's argument, but it's fun to [color=#e23b3b][i]play[/i][/color] video games... Not to watch other people play them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry... But I guess you'll have to find someone else to go to the game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No time to sulk... I'd better find another group to talk to... Fast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, at least there are a few people in the stands...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I guess we didn't convince very many people to come.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's too late to do anything about that. We've just got to get out there and cheer.
All of the cheerleaders run out to the basketball court yelling!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go team!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Woo!
But when it's time for the team to come out... Only four players run out!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Wow, Taylor, what's going on with your basketball team? Is your squad `that` bad that you couldn't even get the players to show up for the game?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Taylor, what's going on with your basketball team? Is your squad [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad that you couldn't even get the players to show up for the game?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Hee hee! See you girls later. I guess this game is over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great, we looked like complete idiots in front of all the Wilson High cheerleaders.
As Porscha runs off, Jacob walks over.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, girls.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jacob, what gives? Where's the rest of the team?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No one else showed up. I guess they figured it was a lost cause.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can't play with only four players... So... I guess we forfeit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, after all of our hard work, I can't believe your team fell apart like this!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `Your' hard work?! It's not exactly like you had a perfect Spirit Week! If you had, I bet things would've been different!
Jacob is right! This Spirit Week could've gone a lot better.
But the good news is you can try again!

nodes.text: Finally, it's time for the big game...
The next morning, $ZOE is getting ready for school as Sam comes into her room wearing a yellow shirt and a short yellow skirt with yellow sneakers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, cousin. Um, what's with the shirt? Didn't you remember? It's class color day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! I totally forgot! What should I do? Taylor will `kill` me if I'm not supporting the squad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! I totally forgot! What should I do? Taylor will [color=#3b78e2][i]kill[/i][/color] me if I'm not supporting the squad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not too late. Let's see what you've got... Hey! What about this yellow bikini? It's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A bikini?! I'll totally get in trouble for breaking the dress code.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's for school spirit! I bet they'd let you slide. You could wear the bikini top with a pair of jeans.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's got to be another way. Hey, I've also got that huge yellow bird costume I wore for Halloween a few years ago. What about that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um... It's your life, but I don't think I can sit next to you today if you're wearing that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's got so much more yellow on it! Hmm... What should I wear?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's time for the freshman-sophomore classes to face the juniors and seniors in a race!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: For the freshmen and sophomores, we've got $Scott!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And for the juniors and seniors, we've got Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: On your marks... Get set... Go!
$Scott and Jacob jump on the tiny pink tricycles and furiously pedal across the gym!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ha ha! Oh man, that's hilarious. Those tricycles are `way` too small.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha! Oh man, that's hilarious. Those tricycles are [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too small.

nodes.text: $Scott and Jacob leap off of the tricycles as they reach the next part of the race.
$Scott and Jacob jump on the unicycles...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Balance... Failing!
$Scott and Jacob both fall off of the unicycles!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: My head...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ouch...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! Looks like the unicycles might have been too difficult to race...
$Scott and Jacob limp to the next part of the race.
They each grab a blind fold and put it on... Then run right into each other!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ouch! You hit me so hard my blindfold fell off...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, no cheating!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But I think I have a concussion...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No exceptions!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe blindfolds weren't a good idea...
$Scott puts his blindfold back on and staggers to the finish line just as Jacob gets there...
They each grab a baseball bat and put their heads down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ten spins each! Go!
The boys start spinning.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa... So... Dizzy...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Can't... See... Straight...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hee hee! This is great.
Jacob and $Scott dizzily make their way to the finish line...
Jacob reaches out and grabs a cream pie first. He smashes it into his face!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jacob wins!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Ha ha! A pie in the face... Classic.
Jacob reaches out and grabs a water balloon first. He smashes it into his face!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I win! I win! I...
Jacob slips on the water!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: My back! Owww!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oops... I guess I should've gone with the cream pies...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, congratulations, Jacob! Thanks for playing, boys.
As Jacob and $Scott leave the gym floor, Taylor turns to you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, $ZOE. Good work on that relay. It really got the crowd laughing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam! $ZOE! What were you thinking with that relay?! Were you trying to `kill` them?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam! $ZOE! What were you thinking with that relay?! Were you trying to [color=#3b78e2][i]kill[/i][/color] them?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess... I guess we made it too hard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it...
Taylor grabs $ZOE's arm and pulls her aside!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, new girl, I don't know what your problem is, but you can't seem to do `anything` right.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, new girl, I don't know what your problem is, but you can't seem to do [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And it just so happens that when we brought you `and` your cousin on the squad, that meant we picked up a spare cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: And it just so happens that when we brought you [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] your cousin on the squad, that meant we picked up a spare cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you following me, $ZOE? What I'm saying is there's absolutely no reason to keep a no-talent disaster like you on the squad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But... I was trying my hardest!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't good enough. Now, you're off the squad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! Please! Just give me another chance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're all out of chances, $ZOE. Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle...
Oh no! You got $ZOE kicked off the squad!
You can't leave her like this... She never even made it to the basketball game!
Won't you try again? For $ZOE's sake?

nodes.text: The next day at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, girls. We've still got a couple days to get people excited for the basketball game. For lunch today, I'm disbanding the popular table.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You heard me! I'm disbanding it. Today, I need all of you to mingle with the commoners. Make them feel special. Get them interested in coming to the game.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But how are we going to do that? Most of them don't know anything about basketball.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So do whatever it takes! Do what cheerleaders do best... Lie, cheat, and flirt! Get those people in the stands on Friday!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's see... Maybe I can convince those nerds to come to the game.

nodes.text: Okay, now split up and get out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, mind if I sit with you guys?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Ugh, who invited the cheer patrol?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: If a cheerleader wants to sit with us, I say we can make room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks... I wanted to talk to you guys about the basketball game on Friday. Can we count on you to be there?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry, sports aren't really our thing.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah, we're more into science, numbers, video games... About as far from sports as you can get.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a second... This basketball game is going to be just like...

nodes.text: Let's see... Maybe I can convince those nerds to come to the game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks... I wanted to talk to you guys about the basketball game on Friday. Can we count on you to be there?

nodes.text: Sorry, sports aren't really our thing.

nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.text: Sure, sure. Why don't you get back to your side of the gym, Porscha? You're not welcome here.

nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.text: Ready, squad? Here come the basketball players!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Woo!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Go team!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go Centerscore!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks, guys! Leave the rest to us.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm open! Pass me the ball!
Kenji dives between two Wilson High guys to throw Jacob the ball! Jacob sinks a shot from the middle of the court!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygoodness! A 3 point shot! We're tied up!
Still later...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey, get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure, just give me the ball.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Come on! Back off already!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy. I'm not letting the school down.
Tom takes a shot, but Kenji slaps it away, and Jacob grabs it out of the air.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice! The boys are really keeping up with Wilson High out there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We might just pull this off...
And as the final seconds run down...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is it! If Andy sinks this 3 point shot, we win!
Andy concentrates and shoots the ball...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He did it! Centerscore wins!
Jacob snags the game ball and grabs a microphone from the announcer...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks to everyone for coming out tonight! We couldn't have done it without you all supporting us...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But more importantly, we couldn't have done it without the cheerleaders! Every year, we go into this game thinking that we're going to lose...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And so we do. But this year, we went in knowing we had a chance to win... Knowing that we had the whole school believing in us.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And that's all because of the squad. Thanks, girls... Oh, and guys, too!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I talked it over with the team, and... Here, we want you to have this.

nodes.text: Howard! You came!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

Howard leans over and gives $ZOE a kiss!
